svg.title: How PrefillAdder admits requests
svg.desc: 2 · Reserve room for the decode of running requests
svg.text: 2 · Reserve room for the decode of running requests
KV pool slots of one GPU · page_size 1
Each running request keeps min(max_new_tokens − generated, 4096) × new_token_ratio slots.
new_token_ratio starts at 0.7 because few requests use all of max_new_tokens.
